examples.label: cerebras
examples.from: Free tier, no credit card. Ultra-fast inference (~2,600 tok/s). 1M tokens/day cap. 8K context cap on free tier.
examples.to: Free tier with payment method required. Ultra-fast inference. 1M tokens/day cap. 64K context on free tier.

examples.label: hugging-face
examples.from: 100K monthly Inference Provider credits for free users. Routes to Fireworks, Together, Hyperbolic, Nebius, Novita, DeepInfra and others. Thousands of models.
examples.to: $0.10/month in Inference Provider credits for free users (subject to change). Routes to Fireworks, Together, Hyperbolic, Nebius, Novita, DeepInfra and others. Thousands of models.

examples.label: kilo-code
examples.from: Free models with no credit card required. kilo-auto/free auto-router routes to minimax/minimax-m2.5:free (80%) and stepfun/step-3.5-flash:free (20%).
examples.to: Free models with no credit card required. kilo-auto/free auto-router dynamically routes to models in the free pool.
